Definition: adverb from the same as G810; dissolutely:--riotous.
BiblicalUsage: The younger son in Jesus' story took his share and wasted it in riotous living in a far country. The word sums up the whole prodigal slide in a single stroke.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the far country always looks like freedom until the money runs out, and the road home starts when a person comes to himself.
